results.hypothesis_statement: Among liquid U.S. common equities, stocks in the top decile of trailing 20-trading-day return, measured at each market close, have a higher mean close-to-close 5-trading-day forward return than stocks in the bottom decile after excluding the most recent trading day from the momentum measurement.
results.evaluation_focus: OHLCV equity momentum hypothesis with correct requirements

parsed.hypothesis_statement: Among liquid U.S. common equities, stocks in the top decile of trailing 20-trading-day return, measured at each market close, have a higher mean close-to-close 5-trading-day forward return than stocks in the bottom decile after excluding the most recent trading day from the momentum measurement.
parsed.hypothesis_rationale: A delayed cross-sectional continuation effect may arise because information is incorporated into prices gradually and investors underreact to firm-specific news; excluding the most recent day reduces sensitivity to short-horizon reversal and microstructure effects. The hypothesis is falsified if the top-minus-bottom decile forward-return spread is not positive in an out-of-sample evaluation under the stated universe and construction.
